notes: Item 19 discloses gross sales data for captive venue licensed (franchised) Panda Express Restaurants only, broken down by venue type: Airport (23 units), Hospital (3), Military (55), University (74), Casino (4), Travel Plaza (8), Total (167). Data covers full fiscal year 2025 (December 29, 2024 to December 27, 2025). Only gross sales metrics are disclosed; no cost, profit, or other financial metrics are provided. The 'Total Gross Sales' row represents the sum across all units in each venue category and is not a per-unit figure; per-unit figures are captured in the Average/Median/Min/Max rows. A separate record for Airport total gross sales is included as a note since no per-unit average was separately stated there (it equals 95,611,179 / 23 = ~4,157,008, consistent with the disclosed average). The pct_above_avg values are taken directly from the 'Percent of Units Exceeding Average Gross Sales' row.
